tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shan pa srog sgrub nag mo'i gsang sgrub bzhugs so/

/ shog 'dra'i skor/ shan pa srog sgrub nag mo'i gsang sgrub dug mda' nag mo zhes bya ba/ 'jigs pa'i ma mo 'bum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shan pa smug nag mi bsrun ma/ /skra yi lan bus nam mkha' khyab/ /sgrol ging chen mo la btud de/ /de yi gsang sgrub bshad par bya/ /brag nag srin mo khros 'dra 'am/ / nags rong mon mo khros 'dra bar/ / stegs bu khru gang la sogs par/ / ro sol dug khrag chag chag gdab/ /dbus su gru gsum mu khyud dmar/ /phyi rim rtsibs bzhi mthing nag ste/ /de phyir thod phreng rdo rje'i phreng*/ /sgo dang rta babs ldan par bri/ /de mtha' me ri 'bar ba 'o/ /steng du khams sa'i dgra gzugs kyi/ /snying gar ling ga bcug pa'i steng*/ /ma mo'i dpal gtor zur gsum la/ /dgra yi ling ga gzugs par bya/ /dpral bar rus la snying gar ming*/ /'doms su bla dwags bris pa yi/ /tha ma bsad pa'i sngags kyis bskor/ /gzhan yang bla ma chos skyong dang*/ /yul lha gzhi bdag gtor ma bsham/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /gnam sa mi dmigs mun pas 'khrigs/ /'jigs pa'i lcags khang sgo med du/ /me yi 'od stong 'bar ba'i gnas/ /dgra bgegs mi thar btson dong gsal/ rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /'jigs byed khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa ru/ /gsod byed nag mo chu gri bsnams/ /glo snying zhal gsol khrag 'dzag cing*/ spyan gsum ral pas gnam sa khyab/ /mche gtsigs mtshon cha'i mi 'od 'phro/ /srid pa'i rlung zhon nad rims gtong*/ /sma ra dmar ser 'bar bar bsgom/ /g.yas na sha za lce spyang gdong*/ /ro la zhon nas dgra snying za/ g.yon na nag mo wa gdong ma/ phyag gnyis zhags pa gri gug thogs/ /mdun na nag mo 'ug gdong ste/ /rgyab na srid pa'i sha za 'bum/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs zor 'phen bsam/ /thun ni nyung nag gri khrag gis/ /ling ga brab pas ma mo yis/ /dgra bo bsad par bsam nas ni/

/ sngags 'di ma yengs bzlas shing brab/ /ā+oṃ khyi kha le nag mos sod/ srog ma tri sod/ snying kha khya (< a > kha ) baṃ/ ya ya sod/ tsa wa bi ri mu sod gha ya sod/ ṇi ya sod/ rak+mo tsit+ta rbad/ de ltar zhag bdun song rjes la/ /rtags ni dgra la sna tshogs 'byung*/ /de nas sngags de'i mjug de la/ /rag mo rag mo ma gzir nan/ khams khug drongs che ge mo'i tsit+ta la rbad sod ya/ de bzlas rang la tshig pa za/ /rmugs dang rgyag snying 'dod pa dang*/ /rmi lam bud med mtshan ma ston/ /de tshe 'og ma gcig pu bzla/ /de nas glo snying mgo khyer nas/ /lan gsum byung dus gtor zor 'phangs/ /'brub khung tsher ma'i me sbar la/ /ma mo 'khor bcas kha gdangs bskyed/ /ling ga dgra dngos bsams la 'bul/ /de yis the tshom med par 'grub/ /gal te 'gyangs shing rtags med na/ /'bod rbad mtha' nas ldog byas la/ /bsad sngags drag (< a > btags ) la bsgrub par bya/ /sod mos nag le kha khyi ā+oṃ/ srog ma tri sod/ snying kha kha bhaṃ/ ya yā sod/ tsa ba bi ri mu sod/ gha ya sod/ ṇi ya sod/ rag mo tsit+ta rbad rbad tsi mo rag /sarba duṣ+taṃ che ge mo sha trūṃ mā ra ya rbad/ de yis nges par 'grub pa yin/ /des kyang 'grub par ma gyur na/ /'bod rbad mgo gsham ldog pa la/ /bsad sngags rbad sngags btags la bsgrub/ / de yis the tshom med pa yin/ /gzhan yang 'grub par dka' ba na/ u ne u ne hūṃ phaṭa/ de ni sngags kyi mgor btags shing*/ myags thum ral rbad/ a a/ i ī/ u ū/ 'di ni sham bu btags la bzlas/ /de yis gsod cing cho 'phrul 'byung*/ /rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs bstan pa'o/ /de yi gnad yig ni/ rdzas gnad na chung nal phrug gam/ lug nag bya nag snying nang du/ dur khrod ras la 'khor lo bri/ /rtsibs brgyad mu khyud gsum pa la/ /rtsibs la rtsa sngags bri bar bya/ /mu khyud ma mo'i spyi sngags bri/ /lte bar ma bh+yo gzab tu bri/ /rgyab tu rten 'brel snying po bri/

/rab gnas byas la lus la bcangs/ /skabs su klad la bskor zhing brdab/ /de yis bran bzhin las byed 'gyur/ /dus gnad rgyu dus bstan pa ni/ /tshes gcig skya rengs dang po nas/ /nyi shar yan chad gtso mo rgyu/ /'byung ba shing gi khams yin no/ /nyi ma dros nas nyin phyed bar/ /g.yas kyi srog gcod rgyu dus te/ /'byung ba me yi khams yin no/ / grib chung lhags nas bya gdang bar/ /g.yon gyi srog gcod rgyu dus te/ / 'byung ba lcags kyi khams yin no/ /sa srod nam phyed tshun chad la/ /mdunagyi srog gcod rgyu dus te/ /'byung ba chu yi khams yin no/ /nyi shar phyed yol sa sros nas/ /nam phyed yol dus rnams su ni/ /gtso 'khor srung mar bcas pa rgyu/ /'byung ba sa yi khams yin no/ khams gshed gnad yig bstan pa ni/ / sgrub dus 'brub khung ling ga la/ /rang nyid tshes gcig gtso mo'i dus/ /shing las grub pa'i gtso mor bskyed/ /ling ga shing gi phur pas mnan/ dgra bo dgug gzhug ling ga sa/ /shar phyogs kha bltas rtsa sngags mthar/ /che ge mo'i srog las mā ra ya thun bh+yo/ rag mo ṇi sha ku ru lu thuṃ rbad/ rag mo kha la tsa thun bh+yo/ rak+ta thun rbad/ tsa la tsa la thun bh+yo/ rtsa tsit+ta rbad/ snying la dun/ rag mo kha la tsa thun bh+yo/ ti tha baṃ ril sa ma ya thun bh+yo/ dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya thun bh+yo/ zhes bzlas shing gi phur pa gdab/ g.yas kyi ma mo rgyu dus su/ /rang nyid me las ma mo'i sku/ /ling ga lcags su bskyed byas te/ /drag po'i me 'gal thun gyis brab/ /thun sngags ram du bsgyur la bzlas/ / g.yon gyi ma mo rgyu dus su/ /rang nyid lcags kyi ma mor bskyed/ /ling ga shing las grub par bskyed/ /mi bsad mtshon lcags drag thun gdab/ /thun sngags suṃ du bsgyur la bzlas/ /mdun gyi ma mo rgyu dus su/ /rang nyid chu yi ma mor bsgom/ /ling ga me las grub par bskyed/ /drag thun dug chus brab par bya/

/thun sngags baṃ du bsgyur la bzlas/ /dus gzhan rnams su gzhung bzhin bya/ /rgyu ba'i phyogs dang bstun pa ru/ kha lta*/ na zor ma chad gces/ dgra bo'i khams de rgyus yod na/ /rgyun du de yi gshed thun brab/ /rgyu dus lus sbrid skyi zing 'jigs/ /nges pa'i dus yin bstun par bya/ /mo mo'i ngan sngags gshor la gtad/ /gnad kyi yang snying mthar thug yin/ /cho 'phrul gnad yig bstan pa ni/ /ma traṃ snying khar brub khung bca'/ /dbus su gtor ma ling ga gzhag /sha'am snying ngam rus pa la/ /phung sa khrag sbyar lce spyang mgo /dmar mo lag na ltas ngan ni/ /spre'u 'ug pa la sogs thogs/ /de yi snying khar k+ṣa yi ge /tha mar ltas ngan thong zhig bri/ /gshin rje wa gdong nag mo yi/ /gzugs bya snying khar yi ge bri/ /srog gcod sha za nag mo ni/ /'ug gdong yi ge phyag mtshan 'dra/ /ma traṃ mgo zur gnod sbyin mo/ /g.yas zur gshin rje g.yon zur du/ /bdud mo'i gzugs gzhag gtong ma'i rtser/ /lha mo'i gzugs bris gzugs par bya/ /rtsa ba'i sngags la 'di btags bzlas/ /he tsa dun po ba la/ de bzlas rang la cho 'phrul 'ongs/ /de nas ma traṃ lha dang gzugs/ /dgra yod phyogs su kha bsgyur la/ /rgyab nas thun gyis brab bya zhing*/ /gang la rbad sngags btags byas nas/ /'di la 'di btags bzlas pa bya/ che ge mo tsa he dang phaṭa ya/ zhes bzlas bskur zhing sngags kyis gzir/ gal te ma nyan ldog la bzlas/ des ni dgra la ltas ngan ni/ /ji ltar rbad pa de ltar 'ongs/ /snga ma'i las mjug mnan pa ni/ /sgrub pa thon dus sngar brtsams pa'i/ /ling ga sbyin sreg gong bzhin bya/ /thun gyis ling ga 'brub khung gzhug /drag po'i thun brab g.yam pas bkab/ /klu yi thebs dus ling ga dang*/ dri chen drod ma yal ba dang*/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum sbal nag khrag /rdza yi ga'u kha sbyar ni/ /dgra bo'i khams gshed kha dog can/ /de nang rdzas dang sdig pa gzhug

/ga 'u'i steng la rdo rje ni/ /rgya gram lte bar che ge nan/ /rwa bzhir ā+oṃ nan āḥnan dang*/ /hūṃ nan s+t+waṃ bha nan bris la/ pha wang brun dang dme pho'i chus/ /byugs la dgra bo'i khams de brtags/ / shing khams yin na klu gnas sar/ /mnan zhing sa tshon sna lngas bskor/ /me khams yin na chu mig rtsar/ /sa khams shing gcig drung du mnan/ /chu khams sa gnyan sba bar bya/ /de ltar mnan pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /rab la mnan dus de ru 'chi/ /'bring la zla ba gcig yin te/ /tha ma zla ba gsum na nges/ /phyi dus zla ba bzhi nges yin/ /de tshe rtags ni ma byung na/ /sa der lha 'dre med pas na/ /sgrub pa mi dgos thun drug go /lan gsum bskyar la mnan par bya/ /de yang gnyen sa gsum bzhir bya/ /de yis the tshom med par 'grub/ / dang po sgrub pa gcig thems nas/ /rtag tu sgrub pa byed mi dgos/ /nyin zhag phrugs gcig thun drug ni/ /byas nas mnan pa gcig pus 'grub/ /'di ltar dang po sgrub pa de/ /lan cig grub nas nam dgos dus/ /nyin zhag gcig gis thun drug 'bad/ las mjug mnan pas 'grub pa yin/ /de yang klu gnyan gnas sa ni/ /nges par dgos pas de ru byed/ /de yis myur du 'grub par yin/ /sgrub par byed pa'i dus su yang*/ /skabs su dmar gtor btang byas la/ /'jigs pa'i skul 'dis bskul bar bya/ /bh+yo mkha' 'gro nag mo mi bsrun ma/ /sha za khrag mig srin mo'i gdong*/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /sku mdog nag mo char sprin mdog /phyag na gsod pa'i mtshon cha bsnams/ /chibs su srid pa'i rlung la bcibs/ / ral pa mtshon cha sha ra ra/ /gcer bu mi lpags stod la dkris/ /mi yi glo snying zhal du ni/ /dmar mo khrag 'dzag rgyun du gsol/ /zhal nas khrag 'dzag kyu ru ru/ /spyan gsum khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /sma ra mtshon cha me ltar 'bar/ /shangs nas 'tshubs ma mtshon char 'gyed/ /ba spu mtshon cha me ltar 'bar/

/mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can/ /gsod byed ma mo chen mo la/ /dgra bo'i sha khrag gtor ma 'bul/ /g.yas na gsod byed sha za mo/ /dmar mo sha za ce spyang gdong*/ /ro la zhon nas sha la za/ /rkan brdab dgra bo'i mig 'bras 'brul/ /lcags sder mtshon chas dgra snying 'byin/ /dmar mo khrag 'dzag zhal du gsol/ /g.yon na nag mo wa yi gdong*/ /pa spu mtshon cha spu gri'i so/ /reg pa tsam gyis mgo lus bregs/ /phyag na zhags pa gri gug thogs/ /lus chings srog rtsa dmar po chod/ /sha za khrag 'thung keng rus mur/ /mdun na srog gcod sha za stong*/ /nag mo 'ug gdong gnam lcags sder/ khrag gi ral pa mtshon cha'i sder/ /mtshon sder dgra yi snying la 'debs/ /gnam lcags mchu yis srog rtsa gcod/ /skad cig stong gsum nyul byed ma/ /rkan rdeb srid gsum snying khrag 'brul/ /stong gsum za zhing srid gsum 'thung*/ /sha za khrag 'thung 'bum gyis bskor/ /sha za dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir byon nag mo las mkhan ma/ /dgra bo'i sha khrag gtor ma 'bul/ /dgra bo sgrol ba'i dus la babs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /dam nyams sha zo khrag la 'thung*/ /bcol pa'i phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /zhes pas bstod cing bskul bar bya/ /skabs su mo rgyud gnad 'bebs bzlas/ kha thaṃ mu kha thaṃ/ ma rag sha khu/ ma ril ma ril ma mo bh+yo/ 'dis ni mo rgyud las la khol/ /zhag re brgya rtsa bzlas pas 'grub/ /kun gyi zab don gnad dril nas/ /dug mda' nag mo gtan la phabs/ /e ma snying tig gsang ba'i bka'/ /yang zab bsrung ba'i don byed du/ /shan pa nag mo'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du/ /dri med 'od zer bdag gis bkod/ /dge bas bstan pa 'phel bar shog /shan pa srog sgrub nag mo'i sgrub thabs dug mda' nag mo zhes bya ba/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul o rgyan rdzong du bkod pa rdzogs so/
/bha wan+tu// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)shan pa srog sgrub nag mo'i gsang sgrub/ -PAGE 384--PAGE 385--PAGE 380-
